ledger: Yahboom ROSMASTER M3 Pro sim-to-real calibration ledger
purpose: Simulation proceeds on provisional values; this records which are provisional so none is ever mistaken for a measurement. A field may be used in simulation while REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT, provided results carry stage=SIMULATION_DEVELOPMENT. It may not enter a physical or sim-to-real claim until VERIFIED_FROM_MEASUREMENT.

fields.note: URDF carries the X3 value and says so. navfm records 80 mm wheels. 20% apart. Converts wheel speed to ground distance, so it lands in `position` silently.
fields.resolution: caliper measurement, or a declared simulation value with the X3 lineage stated

fields.note: URDF half-track ly=0.0850 -> 0.170 full. Yahboom publishes no figure.
Inline box. Inconsistent with the 0.75x0.45 sibling placeholder, which is why that placeholder is not adopted.
Inertia is computed from this by the box formula, shown in the URDF.
navfm robot.py marks it PROVISIONAL, derived from 80 mm wheels plus a typical chassis.
G1.c requires a wall at 1 m to subtend the angle a 64 deg horizontal field predicts, +/-2 deg

URDF models mecanum wheels as plain cylinders. Adequate for body-velocity control; NOT adequate for per-roller slip dynamics. State this before any claim about holonomic execution fidelity -- it is the H2 manipulated variable.
Isaac default until measured. Affects slip, therefore odometry drift.
reference deployment stack: 0.2 m/s at 4 Hz
